item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 08/Sep/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an active southerly airstream, there will still be showers and thunderstorms over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. An anticyclone aloft is expected to cover southern China midweek this week to early next week, the weather will be generally fine and persistently very hot, and winds will be weak over the region. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Tapah will move into inland Guangxi and dissipate gradually today and tomorrow.

Date/Month: 09/09 (Tuesday)
Wind: South force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional showers and a few squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavier in some areas at first.
Temp range: 26 - 30 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
